ruleDefinitions.name: MpiExec Lolbin
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a certain command line flag combination used by mpiexec.exe LOLBIN from HPC pack that can be used to execute any other binary

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mpiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=d8b52ef6aaa3a81501bdfff9dbb96217.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/n\\ 1\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-n\\ 1\\ .*")))
